periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of both eye patches is angled downward at approximately 45 degrees toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a significantly higher vertical-oblique length relative to horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the patch narrows toward the muzzle, creating a clear shift between the center and the lowest point.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shape profile on the posterior edge of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately one-third of the visible distance between the neck and the hindquarters.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide inter-ear spacing with a white fur gap approximately twice the width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth and semicircular apex curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Occlusion of the right cranial pinna and forehead area by foreground foliage.
